title: Flipping every coordinate
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Flipping every coordinate of $x$ gives the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $1-x_i$ for each $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$.
replaced: For $n\ge0$ and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, flipping all coordinates gives the vector $\bar x$ with $\bar x_i=1-x_i$ for every $i\in[n]$.
